payload.claim: CLAUDE.md's prose rule for new text ('New Markdown and new comments take no em-dash, semicolon, contraction, perfect tense, hedge or sentence over 25 words') is broken by the new `_host_survivor_cell` docstring's 'once the rebuttal turn has run' — a present-perfect construction. The `prose` gate's own PERFECT regex (`.saffron/gates/prose.py`) only matches 'has/have/had been' or 'has/have' plus a word ending in '-ed', so the irregular participle 'run' passes the gate untouched even though the sentence is perfect tense.
